subject: Status of our shipment MUC to SGN, 1592 kg
body:
Hello,

could you please tell me the current status of our shipment: Hofmann Textilwerk KG, MUC to SGN, 1592 kg, ready on 2026-11-26? Where is it now?

Petra Hofmann

classification.reasoning: The sender asks for the current status and location of a shipment.
